verdict.rationale: PostHog AI is documented as an in-product analyst. You ask in plain English and it queries data, builds insights, writes SQL, and finds replays. It also does the work, creating dashboards, surveys, alerts and feature flags and starting coding tasks. The same natural-language control is available through the @PostHog Slack bot and the hosted MCP server ("with just plain text questions your agents can ship a feature flag from a prompt"), which a probe confirms is live and OAuth-gated. One hands-on report says the assistant could not create a SQL-based cohort and that typing into it slowed the UI badly; this is a real limitation but not a contradiction of the documented capabilities. missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration that natural-language operation works well, cohort creation via natural language, evidence that the in-app chat performs acceptably (counter to the reported slowdown).
